title: Machine learning-guided TsOH/glycerol fractionation of sugarcane bagasse for fermentable sugar production: Experimental validation and molecular insights.
summary: Random-forest predictions selected bagasse fractionation and hydrolysis conditions; separate experiments confirmed cellulose retention and sugar-yield outcomes. Biomass processing only, without organism engineering.
organization: Jiangnan University; Universidade de São Paulo; University of Belgrade
